study_archetype: narrative/review perspective on imaging biomarkers for coronary plaque vulnerability

reported_items.raw_name: objective: evaluate role of CCTA in identifying vulnerable plaques and risk prediction
reported_items.sub_category: role of CCTA in plaque characterization and prognostication

reported_items.raw_name: study_design: review/discussion of recent trials and imaging advances
data_or_sample: asymptomatic individuals and patients from recent trials (broadly referenced)
methods: use of Coronary Computed Tomography Angiography (CCTA) to assess plaque composition, morphology, and inflammatory activity
outcomes: prognostic value of CAC score and CCTA-derived adverse plaque characteristics for myocardial infarction, stroke, and all-cause mortality
results/conclusion: CCTA and CAC scoring provide incremental prognostic information beyond traditional risk factors and may guide revascularization decisions
reported_items.sub_category: incremental prognostic value and potential clinical utility
